remediation.analysis: The route reflects req.query.name directly into an HTML response using string concatenation and res.send(), allowing an attacker to inject HTML/JS (reflected XSS). The fix is to ensure user-controlled data is HTML-escaped before embedding into HTML.
remediation.remediation_strategy: Escape special HTML characters in the `name` query parameter before interpolating it into the HTML response. Keep the response structure and endpoint behavior unchanged while preventing script/markup injection.
assumptions: This endpoint intends to return an HTML string and does not require rendering unescaped HTML from the name parameter.
No templating engine is currently configured/desired for this minimal change.
